note.en: A tiny turrid collected at 5 m off Manzanillo in 2000. Under 1 cm long, it is only a record.
note.es: Un turrido diminuto recolectado a 5 m frente a Manzanillo en 2000. Mide menos de 1 cm, así que es solo un registro.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
